en.headline: HKU forecasts third-quarter growth of 3.7 per cent, full-year 4.1 per cent
en.dek: The APEC Studies Programme revised the annual figure up by 0.4 points on stronger first-half trade, but expects fourth-quarter growth to slow to 2.8 per cent amid weaker consumer confidence.
body: The University of Hong Kong’s APEC Studies Programme said on Thursday that Hong Kong’s real gross domestic product grew an estimated 3.7 per cent year-on-year in the third quarter, down 0.6 percentage points from the second quarter, as weak consumer confidence weighed on private consumption.

Visitor arrivals continued to support tourism-related service exports, while merchandise trade growth remained near 30 per cent year-on-year, similar to the previous quarter. Gross fixed capital formation accelerated to 10 per cent, private consumption slowed to 2 per cent, unemployment edged up to 3.8 per cent and inflation eased to 1.7 per cent. The government is due to release its advance estimate for third-quarter growth on 3 November.

The same high-frequency forecast puts fourth-quarter growth at 2.8 per cent, the smallest increase in eight quarters, partly because of a high base and expected weakening in external trade amid trade protectionism, Middle East developments and uncertain interest-rate paths. Full-year growth is now projected at 4.1 per cent, 0.4 points higher than the previous forecast, reflecting better-than-expected first-half external trade.

zh.headline: 港大料第三季經濟按年增3.7% 全年預測上調至4.1%
zh.dek: 亞太經濟合作研究項目指上半年外貿較預期理想，帶動全年預測上調0.4個百分點，但消費者信心疲弱令第三季放緩，第四季料再降至2.8%。
body: 香港大學亞太經濟合作研究項目周四公布，本港第三季實質本地生產總值按年增長估計為3.7%，較第二季放緩0.6個百分點，主要受消費者信心疲弱拖累私人消費。
訪港旅客持續上升支持旅遊相關服務出口，貨物進出口按年增幅與上季相若，接近30%。固定資本形成總額升幅加快至10%，私人消費開支升幅放緩至2%，失業率輕微上升至3.8%，通脹回落至1.7%。政府將於11月3日公布第三季經濟增長預先估計數字。
同一高頻預測顯示，第四季按年增長將放緩至2.8%，為八個季度以來最低，部分因比較基數較高，以及貿易保護主義、中東局勢及利率走向不明朗下，外貿動力年底前料會減弱。全年增長預測上調0.4個百分點至4.1%，主要反映上半年外貿表現優於預期。
